notes.title: FREE horror-themed story DLC “Life After Death” out now!
notes.content:
Hello, islanders!

We’re here to let you know that Island of Aito’s free horror-themed story DLC “Life After Death” is out.
This DLC is a direct continuation to two of Island of Aito’s hidden endings; “An isolated incident” and “Mortem sibi consciscere”. You can achieve these endings by finding a syringe via beachcombing and "gifting" it to a girl while Aito's sanity is less than 20%. 
We strongly recommend that you see one of the aforementioned endings before playing Life After Death.

Download the DLC [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163610/Island_of_AIto_Life_after_death/]here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310785/a6d9d613c690b8e0bb19ece1b2f6e04b5a717bfd.png[/img]

What’s new?

- Life After Death DLC can be accessed from the main menu.

- The main game has received some minor stability fixes

- History feature has been added. You can now access message history from the pause menu. Please note that some lines may repeat in the log multiple times due to how certain survival features work.


As always, we would like to thank each and every one of you for supporting Island of Aito. If you have any suggestions / ideas about what you’d like to see added to Island of Aito, don’t hesitate to reach out to us in the forums and tell us about it! 

Happy Halloween! 

Eir, 
Nevan Games Studio

notes.title: Content update 1.02
notes.content:
[b]Hello, islanders![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310785/f719d843b14ba7e0e6c8ec415dd94c99b005db9a.png[/img]

We’ve just rolled out Island of Aito content update 1.02

[b]What’s new?[/b]

[list]
[*]You can now find the island chicken around day 55. Having the chicken at your shelter won’t cost extra resources but it will lower your daily food need by 50%.
[*]Added more random events to the random event pool.
[*]Added a new achievement.
[*]Added a bond progression bar to the girl info screen. Affinity alone won’t get you a girlfriend, you also need to get to know her by talking to her!
[*]Fixed some minor bugs.
[*]Fixed some spelling errors.
[/list]

ATTENTION! Start a new playthrough!
This update will potentially break older save files. If you wish to continue playing your old save file without starting a new playthrough, please opt in to “old-build” by right clicking Island of Aito in your Steam library and selecting →  preferences → betas → old-build. Note that the update will only affect your current playthrough and it will not affect unlocked endings or overall completion percentage / unlocked cards.


[b]Other news[/b]
We’ve been hard at work creating Island of Aito’s upcoming free DLC titled “Life after death.”
Progress has been steady and we’re getting ready to announce the official release date next week!


As always, if you have any suggestions / ideas about what you’d like to see added to Island of Aito, don’t hesitate to reach out to us in the forums and tell us about it!

notes.title: Upcoming content update and DLC progress
notes.content:
Hello, islanders!

Dropping in to let you all know that Island of Aito will get a content update on 19th of September! We’ll be adding a new shelter pet, along with new random events and a hidden event.
 
Progress on the upcoming DLC “Life after death” is moving forward slowly but surely. About 60% of the story is written, background images are done and the rest of the art is designed/sketched out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310785/aeadd498082ed2a9441ed40ffa1b391586e1e877.png[/img]

Have you met her while playing Island of Aito?

As I’ve mentioned before, the DLC will feature a short, interactive story that’s a continuation to two of Island of Aito’s hidden endings; “An isolated incident” and “Mortem sibi consciscere”. No release date yet, but the DLC will be free for all owners of the main game once it’s out.

Eir,
Nevan Games Studio

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0 "We can't speak English"
notes.content: Hi, just a quick hotfix that corrects some spelling errors.

notes.title: Content update 1.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello, islanders!

We’ve just rolled out Island of Aito content update number 1.0

What’s new?
[list]
[*]You can now find the island bunny around day 50. You can choose to bring the bunny to live at your shelter. Having the bunny at your shelter won’t cost extra resources but it will have a positive effect on your sanity.
[*]We’ve adjusted the game’s passive game mode to be slightly easier. Choosing to play in passive mode will make the game more relaxing / less hectic.
[*]Added some warning events that will let the player know if the game is about to end.
[*]Added more challenging random events to the random event pool. Some of the new events will have a huge impact on your health points so tread carefully!
[*]Added a new achievement.
[*]Fixed some minor bugs.
[*]Corrected some spelling errors.
[/list]

Please note that you’ll have to start a new game for most of these changes to take effect.


Other news
[list]
[*]We’ve started working on a free DLC for Island of Aito. More information on the DLC and progress will be posted a bit later.
[*]We’ve started planning / working on a second content update to Island of Aito.
[/list]

As always, if you have any suggestions / ideas about what you’d like to see added to Island of Aito, don’t hesitate to reach out to us in the forums and tell us about it!

notes.title: Content update coming on 18th of July
notes.content:
Hello, Islanders!

Island of Aito has been out for 8 weeks now. We'd like to let you know that we'll release a small content update on 18th of July. The update will include some fixes and added events. Note that this update will be the first of multiple content updates we have planned for the game.

We've also started designing a free DLC for Island of Aito. We can't give an exact release date yet, but we're aiming to release the DLC later this year.

Is there something particular you think should be added to Island of Aito? Is there something that we should change to make it better? Please tell us about it in the forums! We're always open to suggestions.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0 "Let them see the cursor"
notes.content:
This update contains the following fixes

- Made the cursor outline darker so people who play with very high monitor brightness settings can see the cursor easier.

- Corrected some spelling errors.

- Added some transitions.

notes.title: Island of Aito post-release roadmap
notes.content:
Here's what we’ve got planned for Island of Aito’s future. Please note that all post-launch DLC and content will be FREE for anyone who buys Island of Aito on Steam.

[list]
[*][b]We’re going to be adding content to Island of Aito periodically.[/b] This content includes but is not limited to: new random events, new story events, new hidden events.
[*][b]We’re going to support the game actively.[/b] We’ll work our hardest to deliver bug fixes and other fixes as fast as possible. If you encounter any bugs or glitches while playing, please report them at our Steam forums.
[*][b]We’re planning to make a free story DLC titled ”Life after death”.[/b] The DLC will be a direct continuation of one of the game’s secret endings.
[/list]
      
Please don't be afraid to reach out to us in the forums if you have any questions or concerns regarding Island of Aito. We'd also like to give a heartfelt thank you to everyone who has already added Island of Aito to their wishlist.
